name: Planet_S69
uv_convention: Equirectangular. u = (longitude + 180) / 360 with east (positive longitude) to the right; v = (latitude + 90) / 180; PNG top row = north pole (v = 1). Identical to Game.Levels.PlanetCoordinates.ToUv; the globe mesh in PlanetGlobe already uses it.

files.Albedo: sRGB colour, unlit, no clouds. Import sRGB, wrap U Repeat / V Clamp, aniso 8.
files.Height: 16-bit grey, linear. 0.5 = sea level, 0.5..1 land (1 = highest peak), 0..0.5 sea floor.
files.Normal: Tangent space from land relief (sea surface flat). R = +east, G = +north (OpenGL / Unity convention, same as GlobePainter.Normals). Import as Normal map.
files.Mask: Linear. R land 0/1 (antialiased coast), G specular/wetness (sea 1, lakes 0.85, black ice 0.6, snow ~0.5, dry land ~0.1), B glow strength, A region id (same values as Regions.R).
files.Regions: Linear, sample with POINT filtering. R region id on land only, G region id including its sea territory, B soft membership 0..1 for a gentle highlight falloff. id = round(value*255/40).
files.Emission: sRGB glow, multiply by an HDR colour/intensity; strongest on the night side.
files.Clouds: Linear; cover in R, G, B and A (the existing shaders read .a). Wraps in longitude.

region_note: The Core (C6) is the crater on Southern Crown's northern arm at its MapRegion centre (150, -32); its surface id covers the crater to its rim (radius ~10 deg).

shader_hints.Planet_shader: Feed Albedo -> _AlbedoMap with _TextureTint = 1 (the map already carries the biomes; set _Alien = 0 or bypass the procedural land palette), Normal -> _NormalMap, Emission -> _LightsMap with _CityColor ~ (1.6, 1.6, 1.6), Clouds -> _CloudMap. _GlossMap expects sea in .a: use a gloss texture with A = Mask.G, or change the shader to read Mask.r (land) and Mask.g (specular).
shader_hints.relief: _BumpStrength 1.0-1.5 for the map view, 2 for the cutscene; Height can drive a parallax or a sea-depth tint if wanted.
shader_hints.map_view: Lit from the camera side: ambient 0.2, emission x0.4 by day so crystal fields still sparkle.
shader_hints.highlight: Highlight a region by comparing round(Regions.G*255/40) with the selected id; use Regions.B for a soft edge.
